figure: n/a — no figure on this page; displayed equations in §A.9-5 "Geometry: from pixels to tokens"
issue: The token-count equation does not substitute its own stated intermediate values. The page defines H_i = 704/16 = 44 and W_i = 1280/16 = 80, and separately states "There are 109,120 latent spatial-temporal cells, each with 48 channels" (31 × 44 × 80 = 109,120, consistent). But the displayed equation reads N = T_i·H_i·W_i / 2 × 2 = 31 × 22 × 40 = 27,280. Substituting the page's own H_i = 44 and W_i = 80 into the printed left-hand side gives 31 × 44 × 80 × 2 = 218,240, not 27,280. The printed right-hand side (31 × 22 × 40) is consistent with a 2×2 spatial patch (44/2 = 22, 80/2 = 40, matching the stated "denoiser patches the latent video by (1, 2, 2)"), so the result is almost certainly the intended one and the printed formula is the defect: the correct expression is N = T_i · (H_i/2) · (W_i/2) = 31 × 22 × 40 = 27,280. As printed, the equation is dimensionally and numerically self-contradictory, and a reader who checks the substitution will conclude either that the token count is 8× too large or that the cell count is wrong. The same 27,280 figure is then reused in the preceding paragraph ("100 evaluations each process all 27,280 tokens simultaneously"), so the error propagates into the workload description.
evidence: Rendered page 479 (printed 459): "H_i = 704/16 = 44, W_i = 1280/16 = 80"; "N = T_i H_i W_i / 2 × 2 = 31 × 22 × 40 = 27,280"; "There are 109,120 latent spatial-temporal cells, each with 48 channels." Independent recomputation: 31 × 44 × 80 = 109,120 (matches the cell count); 31 × 44 × 80 × 2 = 218,240 ≠ 27,280; 31 × (44/2) × (40/2) = 31 × 22 × 40 = 27,280 (matches the printed result).
acceptance_test: Rewrite the displayed equation as N = T_i · (H_i/2) · (W_i/2) = 31 × 22 × 40 = 27,280, with a one-clause note that the 2×2 spatial patch halves each spatial dimension (consistent with the stated (1, 2, 2) patch). Then re-verify that the same page's cell count (109,120 = 31 × 44 × 80) and the "27,280 tokens" figure quoted in the preceding paragraph remain mutually consistent, and confirm no other chapter quotes a token count for this Wan2.2 T2V-5B configuration that conflicts with 27,280.
